text: I think you'll enjoy this Easy Summer Cucumbers recipe, given your history of liking recipes that include savory flavors. The combination of cider vinegar and celery seed should provide a tangy taste that complements the sweetness of the sugar, which might appeal to your preference for balanced flavors. Additionally, this recipe doesn't contain any ingredients that you've previously shown a dislike for, and it's relatively quick to prepare, taking about 65 minutes.
